name: Hive 1.2.2
notes: macOS file-access fix: agent turns spawn local CLIs (Claude Code, Codex) that read your workspace, and macOS can silently block a turn on a hidden folder-permission modal. Settings -> Permissions now has a File access card that opens Full Disk Access directly, and warns when Hive is running quarantined or App-Translocated (which stops permission grants from persisting). Cleanest install is the Homebrew tap (brew install --cask honeyhive-ai/hive/hive), which avoids the quarantine flag entirely. Builds on 1.2.1's runtime Test button and turn timeout.
